global_organization_chain: official requirement decomposition and three-model roadmap
substrate, stage, reaction, and species-role assumptions
enzyme mechanism and single-fungus kinetic baseline
trait-based competitiveness and pair decomposition extension
Logistic baseline and Lotka-Volterra short/long interaction scenarios
temperature/humidity response interfaces and pair trajectories

main_argument_chains.claim: The paper answers the multi-fungus decomposition requirement with enzyme kinetics modified by species competitiveness and pair-specific substrate logic.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use pair decomposition rankings only for the three selected fungi, assigned substrates, and stated kinetic assumptions.
support_steps: official requirement -> multiple fungi in one patch
reaction scheme and equations 1-6 -> single-fungus kinetics
bounded caveat -> no displayed pair aggregation equation

main_argument_chains.claim: The paper characterizes short- and long-term fungal interactions through independent Logistic growth and Lotka-Volterra competition scenarios.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Interpret the panels as conditional scenario behavior rather than independently calibrated persistence forecasts.
support_steps: bounded caveat -> s is selected from the outcome class

main_argument_chains.claim: Temperature and humidity are propagated through growth, competitiveness, interaction, and decomposition to compare rapid environmental scenarios.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the results as illustrative one-factor scenarios, not quantified atmospheric-trend sensitivity or field validation.
support_steps: bounded caveat -> response equations and thresholds are incomplete

main_argument_chains.claim: Representative temperature and humidity inputs are converted into ranked single and pair alternatives for several named environments.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain the conditional ranking structure while withholding general regional recommendations until inputs, ranges, and missing regimes are resolved.
support_steps: long-term exclusion of competing WR-BR pair
bounded caveat -> arboreal case and reproducible percentage derivation are absent

main_argument_chains.claim: The paper argues that functional diversity can maintain decomposition and recovery as the environment changes.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Learn the organization of the biodiversity argument, but label its ecological conclusion qualitative and unvalidated.
support_steps: bounded caveat -> no diversity or resilience metric is computed

main_argument_chains.claim: The required two-page article translates the technical chain for introductory biology readers without equations.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Reuse the layered audience pattern while carrying forward technical boundaries and avoiding unsupported universal claims.
